sources.entry: ClipBucket - Start your own video sharing website (YouTube/Netflix Clone) in a matter of minutes. (Demo, Source Code) AAL Docker/PHP

summary.one_liner: ClipBucket V5 is a free, self-hosted PHP script for running your own YouTube/Netflix-style video (and optionally photo) sharing website.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ClipBucket as an open source PHP script for launching a video sharing platform, with users able to create playlists, collections, send friend requests, and exchange private messages. It can host a video site, a photo site, or both at once. Listed features include PHP 8.1 to 8.5+ and MySQL 9+ compatibility, UHD resolutions, HLS conversion, subtitles, Chromecast support, age restriction, recursive collections, TMDB integration, dark and light themes, and an AI NSFW check. Installation is offered via a Docker image (full and lite variants) or manual setup on a dedicated server with scripts for beginners. Updates are handled through an admin dashboard when installed with git.
use_cases: host a private or public video sharing website
run a combined video and photo sharing site
self-host a Netflix-like streaming front end with user accounts
how_to_run: docker run --restart unless-stopped --pull=always -e DOMAIN_NAME=clipbucket.local -e MYSQL_PASSWORD=clipbucket_password -e UID=1000 -e GID=1000 -v clipbucket_db:/var/lib/mysql -v clipbucket_files:/srv/http/clipbucket -p 80:80 --name clipbucket -d oxygenz/clipbucket-v5:latest
For an external database, use the lite image: oxygenz/clipbucket-v5:lite (omits MariaDB)

On a dedicated server: install MySQL 5.6+ or MariaDB 10.3+, PHP 8.0+ with mysqli, curl, xml, mbstring, gd, openssl, fileinfo, exec and shell_exec, FFmpeg 3+, mediainfo and sendmail, then use the installation scripts
notable: Ships as a Docker image with a full version (bundled MariaDB) and a lite version for external databases
Built-in self-update from the admin dashboard when installed with git
Integrated database update system and translations in English, French, German, Portuguese and Spanish
Optional AI NSFW check, TMDB integration and HLS conversion
Continuous deployment model where the master branch is the recommended stable version
caveats: The original ClipBucket repository was archived in December 2022; V5 is maintained by Oxygenz
The README says the installation scripts are meant for testing and development purposes only
Only stable versions have been tested, mainly on Debian
